normalizations: SBU reference once; each CHARM profile has equal_event rate r and equal_expected_flip rate r/E[K]

population_contract.selected_payload: 346 S* payload bits only, identical events across schemes; targeted conditional susceptibility, added storage explicitly excluded here
population_contract.paired_base_full: 65370 core bits only, identical events across schemes; added storage explicitly excluded here
population_contract.storage_scaled_full: all 65370 core bits plus actual scheme added check/replica/controller bits; rate r*B_scheme/65370 at equal base per-bit density; common seeds but not identical schedules/sites

location_contract: SBU uniform exposed bit. Core full population uses bit-weighted field then valid within-field logical anchor. Selected population uses bit-weighted natural word then valid within-word logical anchor. Added population uses bit-weighted natural words. If K=2 starts in a one-bit parity word, second distinct bit is uniformly dispersed in total storage: explicitly a logical sensitivity, not a measured physical footprint. Never clip K or repeat an ID within an event.
arrival_contract: Poisson in conditional-branch exposure; Exp(rate) inter-arrivals, all events in [o,o+1) apply before conditional o, no functional step between same-bin events; continuous state for entire trial, reset to same clean warmup once per trial only
rate_status: chosen software stress rates, NOT calibrated target events/second or physical per-bit SEU rate
seed_rule: base + workload_index*1000000 + field*10000 + trial; time/K/location seeds s,s+1,s+2; predictor RNG remains 548, independent
seed_pairing: same trial seed across populations, rates and profiles is deliberate common random numbers; bootstrap resamples matched trial IDs, never counts correlated branches as trials
resource_authority: user no server limits; bounded 8 trial workers after <=100-trial runtime check; serial build
uncertainty: 2000 matched trial-bootstrap replicates within each of six fixed workloads; equal-workload mean; Wilson interval for binary outcomes; no population-of-programs or physical-rate inference
failure_contract: timeout/assertion/invalid event/write error are execution failures retained separately, never masked
implementation_contract: zero-latency atomic behavioral checks before lookup and history read-modify-write. ED and ECC DUE reset S* and disable all tagged providers/allocations for 130 actual control updates, retain bimodal training and original periodic usefulness aging. ECC corrects actual syndrome and writes back; TMR votes bits and repairs all three copies. No injector/golden access by controller.
controller_exposure: ED/ECC: 8-bit refill_remaining + 32-bit history_epoch exposed. Epoch has no functional consumer in non-spec C++ replay; used for future CPU rollback generation. TMR: added replicas only. Statistics/simulator pointers not hardware exposure.
limitations: warmup is a fixed finite-trace condition, not stationary-state proof
no CPU cycles/IPC or pipeline/speculation conclusions from E2
no physical geometry, target radiation rate, PPA or actual RTL latency
CERN footprint and Flying Laptop detection-time stress remain separate later models
